findings.title: Competitor relative positioning distance
findings.evidence_anchor: Wrike closest measured competitor (0.752); ProjectManager most different (0.872); avg_distance=0.821; competitors_analyzed=5.
findings.observation: Among 5 analyzed competitors, Wrike is the closest measured competitor with a distance of 0.752, and ProjectManager is the most different measured competitor with a distance of 0.872, compared to an average distance of 0.821.
findings.bounded_interpretation: If the measured distances reflect current market positioning, the audited brand is positioned closer to Wrike and further from ProjectManager relative to the analyzed group.
findings.limits: Snapshot comparison can support relative positioning distance only; it does not prove superiority, product quality, adoption, customer choice, durable defensibility, or planning direction.
